events.title: Yacht Rock Revue - PRIMETIME
events.description: The popular yacht rock tribute band brings smooth '70s and '80s soft-rock hits to bergenPAC. A fun, sing-along winter night out.

events.title: Freestyle Flashback 2027
events.description: A nostalgic night of freestyle dance music at bergenPAC. Great for anyone who grew up on '80s and '90s club hits.

events.title: David Foster & Katharine McPhee
events.description: Hitmaker producer David Foster and singer Katharine McPhee perform together at bergenPAC. A polished evening of pop standards and Foster's greatest songs.

events.title: You've Still Got a Friend: Carole King & James Taylor Tribute
events.description: A musical tribute to the friendship and songbooks of Carole King and James Taylor. A cozy Sunday-night pick for singer-songwriter fans.

events.title: Marlon Wayans
events.description: Comedian and actor Marlon Wayans brings his stand-up to bergenPAC. A good grown-up night out in downtown Englewood.

events.title: Little River Band
events.description: The classic soft-rock band behind 'Reminiscing' and 'Lady' plays bergenPAC just ahead of Valentine's weekend. Makes an easy date-night plan.

events.title: Calendar Girls (Bergen County Players)
events.location: The Little Firehouse Theatre, 298 Kinderkamack Rd
events.description: Bergen County Players stage the heartwarming comedy based on the true story of English women who made a charity calendar for leukemia research. Long-running local community theater in a cozy historic firehouse.

events.title: The Imaginary Invalid (Bergen County Players)
events.location: The Little Firehouse Theatre, 298 Kinderkamack Rd
events.description: A brisk 95-minute English adaptation of Moliere's satire about a hypochondriac father. A light, funny late-winter outing at one of Bergen's oldest little theaters.

events.title: Urban Bush Women
events.location: Sharp Theater, Berrie Center, Ramapo College
events.description: The groundbreaking Black women-led dance company, founded in 1984, performs at Ramapo College's Berrie Center. A powerful Sunday matinee of theatrical dance.

events.title: Puppy Pals Live
events.location: Sharp Theater, Berrie Center, Ramapo College
events.description: A comedic stunt-dog show starring mostly rescued pups, as seen on America's Got Talent. A great family matinee; everyone, including infants, needs a ticket.

events.title: Ramsey Farmers Market (Winter Hours)
events.description: One of the few Bergen farmers markets that runs all winter, outdoors rain, snow or shine. Leashed dogs are welcome; check the market's Facebook for weather closures.

events.title: New Year's Day Bird Walk at DeKorte Park
events.description: Start the year with a guided Bergen County Audubon bird walk in the Meadowlands. No experience or registration needed; walks run up to two hours.

events.title: Eagle Watch at Overpeck County Park
events.location: Overpeck County Park (meet by the bandshell and restrooms)
events.description: Look for wintering bald eagles with Bergen County Audubon guides. Open to all, no registration needed.

events.title: Meadowlands Eagle Festival
events.description: A winter celebration of bald eagles with guided walks, talks, kids' activities, music and info tables. A fun way to get the family outside in January.

events.title: Eagle Watch at River Barge Park
events.description: A guided Bergen County Audubon eagle-spotting walk along the Hackensack River. Beginners welcome.

events.title: Save the Eagle's Day on Bell Drive
events.description: Drop by an afternoon eagle-viewing gathering hosted by Bergen County Audubon. Bring binoculars and dress warmly.

events.title: Eagle Watch at Hackensack River County Park
events.location: Hackensack River County Park (entrance behind the Shops at Riverside)
events.description: A midweek guided eagle walk tucked behind the Shops at Riverside. No registration needed.

events.title: Bergen County Audubon Walks at Teaneck Creek & Frank Chapman Trail
events.location: Teaneck Creek Conservancy (Puffin Way lot) / Frank Chapman Trail (River Rd & Riverview Ave)
events.recurrence_text: Jan 3 & Jan 27 at Teaneck Creek; Jan 31 at Frank Chapman Trail
events.description: Easygoing guided winter bird walks in Teaneck's nature preserves. No birding experience or registration required.

events.title: Winter Afternoon Forest School
events.description: A play-based outdoor after-school program for kids ages 3.5 to 7 in the Tenafly Nature Center woods. Rain gear is loaned from the center's gear library; registration required.

events.title: Zoo Lights at the Bergen County Zoo
events.location: Bergen County Zoo, Van Saun County Park, 216 Forest Ave
events.description: Friends of the Bergen County Zoo say a new 'Zoo Lights' event is coming, with details to be announced; 2026-27 dates not announced. The zoo's previous lantern show, Let It Glow, ran from November into January.

events.title: Lunar New Year Flower Market & Lion Dance Parade
events.location: Fort Lee Borough Hall and Main Street
events.description: 2027 date not announced; was Sunday, February 15, 2026 at 12 PM. Hosted by the Chinese American Community of Fort Lee, it featured a blessing ceremony, lion dances down Main Street, an outdoor flower market, food trucks and performances.

events.title: Lunar New Year Celebration at Palisades Park Library
events.location: Palisades Park Public Library, 257 Second St
events.description: 2027 date not announced; was Wednesday, February 11, 2026, 3pm-6pm. The library hosted cultural performances and traditional activities for all ages.

events.title: Lunar New Year Spectacular at American Dream
events.description: 2027 date not announced; was Sunday, February 15, 2026, 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM. The mall celebration featured lion dances, dance performances and kung fu demonstrations.

events.title: MLK Birthday Committee of Bergen County Celebration
events.description: 2027 date not announced; was Monday, January 19, 2026 (MLK Day), 6:30 pm - 9:30 pm. The county committee's evening program honors Dr. King with music, poetry and scholarship awards; MLK Day 2027 falls on Jan 18.

events.title: MLK Day Oral Histories & Roundtable at Tenafly Public Library
events.description: 2027 date not announced; was January 19-20, 2026, 10:00 am - 3:00 pm. Eloquence Academy hosted an oral history project and civil rights roundtable discussions.

events.title: Valentine's Day Brunch on the Farm
events.location: Fresh and Fancy Farm, 575 River Rd
events.description: 2027 date not announced; was Saturday, February 14, 2026, 11:00 AM to 1:30 PM. A family-friendly Valentine's brunch at a local farm.

events.title: Mama and Me Valentine's Day Art Party
events.description: 2027 date not announced; was Saturday, February 14, 2026, 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM ($42 per mother and child). A Valentine's art session for moms and little ones.

events.title: Love Potion Jars at Mahwah Public Library
events.description: 2027 date not announced; was February 13, 2026, 3:30 PM to 4:30 PM. A Valentine's craft program at the library.

places.name: Ice House (Public Skating)
places.price_text: $25 per session online, $30 at the booth (skate rental included)
places.description: A four-rink indoor skating facility with public sessions that include skate rental; the session schedule is posted on its site ('stay tuned' as of Nov 2026).
